boundedKeyset.question: Does the packaged 0.1.7 inline-handler ctx.db chain support the bounded keyset verbs Diary 0034 used on repo main (.lt/.gt/.order/.take)?
boundedKeyset.method: listMessagesPage rewritten as withIndex('by_channel').eq(...).gt('_version', boundary).order('_version','asc').take(6); codegen accepted it; first-page runtime call failed.
boundedKeyset.conclusion: Bounded keyset reads are not on the packaged 0.1.7 handler surface; codegen does not statically reject the unknown chain verbs, and the runtime failure names no missing method. The arm shipped collect+sort+slice instead.
boundedKeyset.evidence: evidence/app/functions.mjs (listMessagesPage NOTE), debug-take.mjs retained in the external build dir

presenceWedge.question: Why does useSnapbackPresence/observeSnapbackPresence never reach 'ready' in the A2 UI?

matrix.setup: provider with NO live-query observers, managed presence value
matrix.outcome: room live, publisher published, entries delivered (Bob, first run)

matrix.setup: provider with active observeSnapbackQueries observers, managed presence value
matrix.outcome: room stuck connection='connecting', status 'stale', publisher 'publishing' forever; deltas from OTHER publishers still arrive
identical wedge (selfKey adopts the label; room still never ready)

matrix.setup: dedicated presence-only provider per persona over the same session bearer
matrix.outcome: both personas ready+published, entries [Alice, Bob] on both sides (retained ui-smoke.json)

presenceWedge.headlessContrast: SnapbackClient.subscribeEphemeral overlays multiplexed with concurrent live queries on separate connection labels worked throughout the acceptance suite (A2-05, A2-11).
presenceWedge.conclusion: React-arm managed presence room fails to complete its readiness handshake whenever the same provider already owns live-query subscriptions; finding 0137-a2-f1.

ephemeralReferenceMismatch.question: Why is api.ephemeral.chatPresence refused by the prepared React binding?
ephemeralReferenceMismatch.conclusion: canonicalizeClientValueV1 comparison fails on schemaVersion alone, so every generated ephemeral reference is rejected with SNAPBACK_REACT_REFERENCE_INVALID; workaround is binding.ephemeral.<name>; finding 0137-a2-f2.
